opis: A cosy TEA PARTY on the meadow from the reference picture, late afternoon in golden autumn light. In the middle stands the little HEDGEHOG's new HOUSE built of big flat shapes, exactly like a child's drawing: a big blue SQUARE for the walls; a PLAIN yellow TRIANGLE roof on top with nothing on it; ON THE BLUE WALL, on the right, a round red CIRCLE window; on the left of the same wall a green upright RECTANGLE door standing open. In front of it a small round wooden table with four cups of tea and FOUR plates of golden biscuits: one plate of round biscuits, one of square biscuits, one of triangle biscuits, one of rectangle biscuits. The little HEDGEHOG, the host, stands proudly at his open door pouring tea from a teapot; the FOX, the OWL and the BUNNY sit round the table holding biscuits, laughing. A square kite on a string is tied to the house and flies high in the sky. A few autumn leaves on the grass. Warm, happy, homely.
